content:
In Russian, HTML is typically spelled as **ХТМЛ** or **ХТ-ЭМ-ЭЛ** (if spelling out each letter).

The most common way is **ХТМЛ** - this is how Russian speakers naturally write it in Cyrillic when they want to avoid Latin letters.
